name: The Iron Breath Commune
description: A scattered network of Aelerian engineers, outcast smiths, and Ngomebe stone-cutters who have rejected the orthodoxies of their homelands. They build, mend, and hide—specializing in breath-counters, bell-wire, and walking-city bearings. They are paid in stories, components, and promises of safe haven. They have no single leader, only a shared belief: that craft is the only honest law.
location: Aelerian under-vaults and Ngomebe caravan routes
leverage: Access to rare components, certified breath-counters, repair services that leave no trace, and knowledge of hidden under-passes.
debtTrigger: When Obligation fills, the Commune demands a 'sharing'—a piece of knowledge, a new engineering concept, or a dangerous salvage operation for a rare material. They will not take no for an answer.
quirk: Every member carries a small brass bell that rings only when a lie is spoken nearby. They never discuss the origin of the bells.
keyNPCs: Master Korr (a one-eyed Aeler who forged a working breath-counter from scrap and keeps the Commune's memory)
Palla (a Ngomebe stone-cutter with a prosthetic leg made from a walking-city bearing—she 'misplaced' the original)
The Scrivener (a silent figure who writes in a code no one has cracked; they are the Commune's memory-keeper)
hooks: A desperate Ngomebe caravan master needs a new bearing for a city that is losing its path. The Commune can supply it—but only if you retrieve a fragment of a First City keystone.
An Aeler vent-prior is hunting the Commune for 'theft of breath'—he claims they have a working model of an ancient pressure engine.
A sect of Root-binders has offered the Commune access to a grove of living stone in exchange for a bell-line that rings only in silence.
